name: Poison ~6 Nin no Majo~
source:
Princess ate a gifted candy and fell into slumber. No one answered the king's call to lift the curse until protagonist showed up. He set on a journey to defeat six witches in undressing card game to get the cure.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-february-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公主吃了一颗赠予的糖果后陷入了沉睡。在主人公出现之前，没有人回应国王解除诅咒的呼唤。他踏上了通过脱衣卡牌游戏击败六位魔女以获得解药的旅程。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-february-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
